'''Onassi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] of the [[Alliance of Free Planets|Alliance]] [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Special Forces]].<ref name="SW98" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], he held the rank of [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] and fought during the [[Liberation of Ord Vaug|liberation]] of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Vaug]].<ref name="VEaA" /> Having found the two remaining [[Venerated Ones]] of [[Vandelhelm/Legends|Vandelhelm]] being held prisoner on the planet, Onassi requested that someone escort them to their homeworld and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was later picked for the mission.<ref name="SW98" />
